FICTIONAL REPORTING ORDINANCE — AMENDMENT EFFECTIVE 1 APRIL 2026

Section 8A

In Section 8, “100” is replaced by “75” and “10 calendar days” by “5 calendar days”. Section 8A prevails over Section 8 in the event of conflict for thresholds exceeded on or after 1 April 2026.

This text is a synthetic temporal fixture. It is not legal authority.
